data.name: Mushir
data.gender_notes: Mushir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Advisor, Counselor, or one who gives guidance
data.long_meaning: Mushir is an Arabic name that means advisor or counselor. It signifies someone who provides guidance and wisdom to others. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with qualities of kindness, justice, and bravery. The name Mushir carries the meaning “Advisor, Counselor, or one who gives guidance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mushir usually hope their child will grow to embody advisor, counselor, or one who gives guidance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who seeks guidance from Allah and gives counsel to others based on Islamic principles.
data.etymology: Mushir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Advisor, Counselor, or one who gives guidance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mushir total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mushir holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world, as it carries the essence of leadership, wisdom, and counsel. Historically, we see several figures in Islamic history who held the title Mushir, such as Mushir Al-Din Ibrahim, the Ayyubid vizier who ruled Egypt, and Mushir Al-Din Muhammad Khudadad bin Al-Hasan, the Persian and Turkic author and historian. These men excelled in their roles as advisors and counselors, guiding their communities and empires towards progress and success. Today, the name Mushir is a reminder that being a trusted advisor or counselor is an admirable trait, and one that can contribute greatly to one's community and society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mushir holds great significance as it is a reflection of Allah's attribute as The Wise and The Knowing (Al-Hakim). The one carrying the name Mushir is expected to embody these qualities in their daily life, acting as a source of guidance and wisdom to others. Additionally, the name Mushir is a reminder of the hadith of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), "Verily, Allah's creation is divided into three groups: prophets, missiows [sic], and scholars." This hadith emphasizes the importance of knowledge and the role of scholars in spreading knowledge, making the name Mushir not only a badge of honor but a privilege and responsibility. By striving to achieve these noble qualities, the bearer of this name can not only contribute to their community's well-being but also draw closer to Allah, seeking His pleasure and following His guidance as laid out in the Quran and Sunah.
